title: parietaria officinalis var. erecta
intro: Parietaria officinalis var. erecta, commonly known as the common Pellitory or Parietaria, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an expectorant. The therapeutic actions of Parietaria officinalis var. erecta include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its efficacy in treating conditions like asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
